title: Transparent failover decision logger and circuit audit
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: debugging regional failovers and SLO-driven load-shedding has repeatedly required correlating traces with ad-hoc logs and customer tickets. Engineers lack a consistent, queryable record of why a request was routed, shed, or tripped by a circuit. This PR introduces a transparent decision-logging pipeline that emits structured per-request decision traces (sampled) from the failover router and circuit-enforcer so operators can audit and replay routing decisions. Changes include: 1) a lightweight decision logger that records the decision path (policy match, SLO bucket, circuit state, fallback chosen, region/zone metrics snapshot) as a structured JSON event; 2) integration hooks in the regional failover router, SLO enforcer, and circuit-breaker module; 3) a sampled export path to the observability pipeline (default sampling 1%, 100% when a region is in degraded mode) with opt-in 100% tracing via feature flag for incidents; 4) redaction rules to strip PII and prompt content; 5) a small hotfix to avoid a duplicated load-shed event when KV-drain and preemption race; 6) unit + integration tests and a canary rollout plan. Checklist: - [x] unit tests for decision logger and redaction - [x] integration tests with regional failover scenarios - [x] manual canary in us-west-2 (2 zones) - [x] docs updated (observability/decision-logs.md) - [x] Feature flagging and migration plan in rollout notes Backwards compatibility: recorded events are additive and opt-in; consumers of the observability topic will see a new event type (decision.audit.v1) and should ignore unknown fields. Performance: micro-benchmarks show ~0.4% p50 and ~0.6% p99 overhead at baseline canary traffic when sampling at 1%; under 100% tracing overhead is higher but permitted under incident feature flag. Deployment plan: staged canary -> 25% -> 100% for all regions; feature-flag kill-switched to rollback quickly. Migration note: a shim is included to backfill decision traces for the last 72h from existing router logs (best-effort) during rollout.

release_notes: Adds decision audit events (decision.audit.v1) for failover, SLO-enforcer, and circuit-breaker decisions. Default sampling 1% with incident mode for 100% tracing. Includes hotfix preventing duplicated load-shed during KV drain. Observability consumers should opt into the new event type.
notes: Operators: to enable full tracing during incident triage set feature flag 'decision_logger.force_full=true' in runtime config. Backfill shim will attempt to populate events for ~72h of recent router logs; this is best-effort and disabled by default. Audit events are sent to the observability topic with tenant id hashed; raw prompt data is redacted by default.
canary_results: Canary in us-west-2 (2 AZs) at 5k rps baseline: decision events sampled at 1% showed end-to-end export latency median 5ms, p99 42ms. No customer-facing errors observed. Canary validated rollback path via feature flag.
